thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 -> inference-prod-usw2: ALB target-group reporting elevated TLS handshake failures (30% unhealthy). Error spike hitting hosted API in us-west-2. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/lb-tls. Pager sent to oncall and netops.

eli (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. :eyes: Starting triage — will gather dashboards and logs.

pagerduty: Ack by eli (1m). If unacked by network in 3m, will escalate automatically.

maria (netops): I'm paged and joining. Pulling target health and recent deploys.

eli (oncall): Checking ALB target health now:
```
$ aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:123456:targetgroup/inference-prod-usw2/abcd1234
{
  "TargetHealthDescriptions": [
    {"Target":{"Id":"i-0a1b2c3d"},"TargetHealth":{"State":"unhealthy","Reason":"TLS_HANDSHAKE_ERROR"}},
    {...}
  ]
}
```

kevin (edge): Heads up — we rolled envoy config 2026-03-14T17:12 UTC that tightened TLS policy. I'm rolling back that change now on the edge fleet.

eli (oncall): Can we confirm certificate validity and SNI? TLS handshake errors often come from cert mismatch or ALPN. Checking certs on backends.

maria (netops): Looking at instance logs: several entries like `tls: remote error: bad certificate` and `handshake failure` from the backend listeners.

eli (oncall): That looks like a client auth / SNI mismatch. kevin — did the envoy change enable mTLS or require client certs?

kevin (edge): Not intentionally. The patch modified outbound TLS settings to prefer strict ALPN and added a new TLS profile. It may have propagated to some targets. Reverting now (rollback started).

incident-bot: Change detected: deployment rollback initiated by kevin. Notifying stakeholders.

eli (oncall): While rollback completes (2-4m), let's fail traffic to the standby target group to reduce customer impact. Plan: update ALB forwarding to inference-prod-usw2-standby and keep TTL at 60s.

maria (netops): Performing weight shift now. Command: `aws elbv2 modify-rule --rule-arn arn:... --actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=arn:...-standby` — applying gradual shift.

eli (oncall): Note: DNS TTL is 60s for edge endpoints but many clients will still hit cached routes. We'll monitor 5xx rates and errors by region.

sylvie (support): Customer A (account #A-123) reported 502/503 errors about 2m ago. I've messaged them: "We see increased errors in us-west-2 and are failing over traffic. We'll update in 10 minutes."

pagerduty: If condition persists for 15m, escalation to oncall-sre will happen automatically.

kevin (edge): Rollback finished on 6/7 nodes; one node showing image pull delay — remediating.

maria (netops): Health checks showing improvement: main group unhealthy -> 5% then dropping. Standby group healthy 100%.

eli (oncall): Running a smoke test against /v1/generate to validate end-to-end:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer redacted' -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .
# response: {"id":"r_abc123","object":"generation","choices":[{"text":"pong"}]}
```

sylvie (support): Customer A confirms errors decreased and API responses returned to normal. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Pager cleared — all targets healthy and error rates back to baseline for the us-west-2 cluster. 

eli (oncall): Closing the page now but I'll own the postmortem. Preliminary root cause: envoy TLS profile change rolled to edge targets without a canary, causing TLS handshake failures on some backends.

kevin (edge): I'm adding a revert-safe gate and canary for envoy TLS profile changes. PR will include CI checks for TLS handshake smoke tests. Apologies for the disruption.

maria (netops): Action: add TLS handshake health checks to target group (validate cert + ALPN) and add alert rule for `TLS_HANDSHAKE_ERROR` > 5% sustained.

eli (oncall): Postmortem owner: eli. Action items assigned: kevin -> deploy gating & canary (ETA 2d), maria -> health-check + alert rule (ETA 1d), sylvie -> customer comms template update.

eli (oncall): Handoff to morning oncall @alice for follow-up and postmortem review. Current status: rollback complete, traffic stable, root cause identified, postmortem planned.

alice (oncall-morning): Thanks — I'll pick this up in the AM and run the RCA meeting.
